### Core Changes

- Turbopack: Update to swc_core v50.2.3 (#87841) (#88296)
  - Fixes a crash when processing mdx files with multibyte characters. (#87713)
- Turbopack: [mimalloc](https://microsoft.github.io/mimalloc/) upgrade and enabling it on musl (#88503) (#87815) (#88426)
  - Fixes [a significant performance issue](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/88426) on musl-based Linux distributions (e.g. Alpine in Docker) related to musl's allocator.
